title: Carol Detweiler
description: Literary site for 'A Murder of Crows Fly with a Red Ribbon' with parallax and interview hub.
longDescription: Book showcase site featuring a parallax hero, YouTube interview embeds, and immersive literary design.

title: AllInOne
description: Zero-backend, offline-ready party game platform featuring 50+ mobile arcade and tabletop games with custom physics and procedural audio.
longDescription: A complete, dependency-free interactive game studio and party hub built for mobile and tabletop play. Features 50+ standalone game modules running 100% client-side, dynamic multi-palette CSS theming, Retina-scaled (DPR 2.5) HTML5 Canvas rendering, mathematical Bézier curve drawing smoothing, device orientation gyroscope tilt controls, zero-asset Web Audio API procedural sound synthesis, and an embedded in-app QA test rig and error-trapping engine for live runtime mobile diagnostics.

title: Rick Detweiler
description: Research-driven website translating a study of 1,000 graduates into clear findings and an interactive college decision experience.
longDescription: A research-focused website that makes findings from a study of 1,000 graduates approachable and useful. It presents evidence about the college experiences associated with long-term outcomes—including faculty and student involvement, broad study, and challenging coursework—and guides visitors toward a two-minute quiz designed to help them ask better questions when evaluating a college.

title: Radia
description: Privacy-first social experience encouraging real-world connection through nearby encounters and guided conversation prompts.
longDescription: A prototype for intentional, in-person connection. Its interface combines proximity-based encounters, synchronized conversation prompts, and a personal reflection log designed around on-device storage. The experience makes privacy a visible part of the product while encouraging users to notice their surroundings, start conversations, and reflect on them afterward.
